gatoh.utils.NodeChanges(opinion, ...)

Dataclass that stores all the relevant information needed to update GraphNodes in the model's base graph.

gatoh.utils.EdgeChanges(hierarchy, weighting)

Dataclass that stores all the relevant information needed to update GraphEdges in the model's base graph.

gatoh.utils.pygraph_to_pydigraph(input_graph)

Transform an arbitrary rustworxk.PyGraph to a rustworkx.PyDiGraph object where each unidirectional edge in the PyGraph becomes two opposing monodirectional edges with weight equal to the original.

gatoh.utils.watts_strogatz_graph(n, k, p, seed)

Returns an undirected Watts-Strogatz small-world graph generated using rustworkx.

gatoh.utils.watts_strogatz_creator(n, k, p, ...)

A helper function that performs the actual Graph object creation for the multidispatched functions above.

gatoh.utils.connected_watts_strogatz_graph(n, k, p)

Returns a connected, directed Watts-Strogatz small-world graph.
